passage:
Every Saturday morning, volunteers cook soup at the community center. The soup is given to anyone who needs a warm meal.
Students from Class 810 went there to help. They expected to cook, but their first job was washing vegetables. Then they cleaned tables and carried bowls.
One student said, "We did not do much."
A volunteer answered, "A meal is made of many small jobs. If one job is missing, the meal is harder to serve."
Later, the students watched people drink the soup and smile. They understood that help is not always exciting. Sometimes it is quiet work that makes other good things possible.
